messages:
lia: Noticed SLO tiles still show alert counts when route quiet-mode is enabled. Owners are confused in staging.
tom: Repro. Quiet stops notification fanout but our summary API returns raw_counts which the UI uses for burn.
priya: Sounds like API contract mismatch. Recommend adding server-side `effective_burn` and `quiet_meta` so UI can display accurate outgoing burn.
lia: Agree. Also frontend caches `/slo/summary` for 30s which makes spikes stick around. Maybe reduce TTL to 5s for tenant-scoped cards.
tom: Plan: server computes `effective_burn = raw_count - suppressed_count` behind a feature flag; emit telemetry `slo.burn.raw` and `slo.burn.effective`.
priya: UI should prefer `effective_burn` when present and show a small pill: "Quiet mode active until <ts>  Notifications paused". Keep raw_count visible as secondary labeled "raw signals".
lia: Tests needed: overlapping quiet windows, backfilled quiet ranges, and cache TTL effects.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled on staging 2026-04-03 08:00 UTC with tag `quiet-aware-burn`. Follow rollout checklist.
tom: I'll open RFC + server PR. Priya, can you own banner copy and the tiny rollout banner that says "staged quiet-aware counting"?
priya: Yep. Sync 15m tomorrow 10:00 PT.
lia: Also add a telemetry alert if `abs(raw - effective) > 10` for > 5m after rollout.
priya: Noted. Thanks.
deploy-bot: NOTE: include unit tests for window union and late-arriving events in PR."
